reviewer: Codex, direct visual inspection through view_image
method: Poppler pdftoppm 26.07.0, PNG at 125 dpi. Every final page was opened and visually inspected after the final rebuild. Earlier render inspection was not substituted.
criteria: No clipping, overlaps, missing glyphs, broken equations or tables observed. Headers/footers and page numbering inspected; title page intentionally unnumbered.

pages.note: Title, subtitle, author accents, actual date, review-pending status, abstract rates and strict fraction legible; contribution statement fits.
Introduction and navigation resolve; registration raw order, yaw and periodic-distance hypothesis readable.
Finite tents, original exchange signs and storage factors, empty launch, nonzero drive and ceiling legible; page number clear.
Theorem 3.1 and boxed (3.3) retain fixed-before-phase quantifiers and allowed equality; strong regularity and weighted cancellation readable.
Zero-norm regularization, chain rule, both native-coupling factors, Volterra iteration, factorial remainder and hyperbolic bounds legible.
Strong-reference argument precedes residual; negative propagation and positive receiver terms, weighted norm and finite error legible; positivity prerequisite precedes normalization.
Exact series ratio, strict sinh and cosine bounds, 1053/4096 margin and equivalent finite parameter choice readable without clipping.
Combined-stock/ceiling interpretation, excluded endpoint, separate receiving/recovery hypotheses, original accessibility notation and evidence status legible; adjacent citations separated.
Outlook starts with its heading; geometric distinctions, parked agenda and conclusion/review-pending status readable.
All 12 units rows, caption and explicit cancellations readable; R squared retained in inverse-time dimensions.
Five full references fit; three immutable edition links and distinct theorem roles readable; no missing glyphs.
